claims.claim: The included code implements a bounded deterministic recursive policy search.
claims.caveat: Executable implementation, not autonomous foundation-model self-improvement

claims.claim: The frozen synthetic demonstration's candidate passes the predeclared internal holdout gate.
claims.caveat: Artificial labels; results are not independent external validation

claims.claim: An oracle-aware conventional policy reaches the synthetic test ceiling.
claims.caveat: The synthetic rule is explicit in the implementation

claims.claim: An external reviewer independently reproduced the demonstration.
claims.caveat: CI and local replay are not independent scientific replication

claims.claim: The method improves real scientific reasoning beyond strong alternatives.
claims.caveat: Requires externally sourced tasks, blinded holdout and credible baselines

claims.claim: The mechanism demonstrates an EFMW-specific cognitive effect.
claims.caveat: Ordinary policy optimization is an adequate explanation for the toy task

claims.claim: MillieComplex has autonomously improved the underlying model's weights.
claims.caveat: No weights are accessible or modified in this repository
